Purpose: Provide local snow accumulation around solid forms without changing their support rules.

Visual brief: A low smooth mound with a blue-violet seated underside, a broad lit top and wind-striations that merge into the fill; a cornice has visible rock underneath, not a floating white rectangle.
Geometry: proposed visual envelope only; Claude supplies exact foot, solid footprint, overhang, interaction anchors and any deck after review.
Implementation: concept only, outside the live piece library. Do not place, bake or grant gameplay until reviewed and approved.
Width 1-3 cells; drift height is visual only. A blocking bank or overhanging cornice requires separate tier/footprint authoring.
Proposed check: no drift may conceal an authored rim, safe landing or quest interaction point.
Lighting: upper-left key light; shade each material and facing for that light. The lit-picture reference is deferred until art exists.
